Subject: Post-demo: Reranker integration & eval questions / next steps

Hi Sofia / Ravi 

Thanks again for your time today  great conversation and appreciate you walking us through the BrightSearch relevance goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: improve result ordering for FAQ + KB search verticals using a reranker on top of your existing embedding-based recall.
- Integration ask: confirm SDK auth (API key vs mTLS) and routing (hosted vs private), and whether you want Redwood to host the reranker or provide the model for you to run on Dedicated.
- Eval scope: you asked about metrics and sample sizes; we recommend starting with a 1k-5k labeled eval set, reporting Precision@k, NDCG@k (k=3,5,10), and MRR, plus qualitative checks.

Technical follow-ups for your engineering team: 
1) SDK setup: we can provide a Python snippet to call our ranking API (POST /v1/rerank) and a Node example.
2) Auth: hosted API works with API keys; for Private/Dedicated we support mTLS or KMS-managed keys.
3) Routing: we support a two-stage pipeline  ANN recall (embeddings) + cross-encoder rerank for top_k. Typical config: top_k_recall=100, rerank_top_k=10.
4) Structured/tool outputs: if you want structured scoring or debug tags per result, our response payload can include per-candidate scores, tokens, and provenance tags.

Attachments: I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed milestones and an eval template.

Next steps: can you confirm the following by EOD Friday?
- Which deployment mode you prefer (hosted vs dedicated/private)
- Whether you can share a representative sample of queries + gold labels (anonymized)
- Preferred auth method (API key vs mTLS)

Cc'ing Dylan (SE) to follow up on the SDK snippet and sample eval config.

Thanks

Hey Sofia  quick technical answers and a short integration plan.

1) ANN store vs Redwood recall
- Option A (minimal change): Keep your FAISS store; call Redwood reranker with the top-100 candidate IDs + text payload. We'll accept an array of {id, text, metadata}. This keeps your recall infra and lets us focus on reranking.
- Option B (managed): We can host an ANN index on Redwood Dedicated/Hosted. Benefits: simpler pipeline and optional nearline updates; downside: ingest step and egress considerations.

2) Model recommendation & latency tradeoffs
- Hybrid (embed recall + cross-encoder rerank) is the standard production pattern. Steps:
  a) Use your embedding recall to fetch top_k_recall ~= 100.
  b) Call Redwood /v1/rerank cross-encoder to score those 100 and return rerank_top_k (default 10).
- If latency is tight (<50ms p50 for rerank), you can: reduce top_k_recall to 50 and rerank_top_k to 5, or use a lightweight interaction-only cross-encoder (smaller model) for faster scoring.

3) Auth & network
- Hosted PoC: API key in header (Authorization: Bearer <key>).
- Dedicated/Private: we support mTLS; provisioning usually takes ~3-5 business days for cert exchange and network peering depending on customer's security approvals. Our onboarding doc lays out steps  happy to coordinate with your infra team.

4) Eval metrics & thresholds
- Recommended metrics: NDCG@5, NDCG@10, Precision@1, Precision@3, MRR, and pairwise win-rate vs baseline.
- Acceptance thresholds (example, depends on vertical):
  - NDCG@5: > 0.45-0.55 improvement vs baseline is a strong win for most KB/FAQ workloads.
  - Precision@1: target uplift of +5-8% absolute for visible wins.
- We'll produce a per-query breakdown and grouped analysis (query cluster, intent) so you can see where the model helps/harms.

5) SDK snippets
- Python (example):

import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer <API_KEY>", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
payload = {"query": "How do I reset my password?", "candidates": [{"id":"c1","text":"To reset your password..."}, ...], "top_k": 10}
r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(r.json())

6) Next actions I can take this week:
- Share a minimal SDK sample (Python + Node) and a Postman collection.
- Run a small offline eval if you can drop an anonymized 1k sample in the Drive folder.

Marissa  attaching the eval template (same as in MAP). Sofia / Ravi  if you can confirm the export timeline, we can schedule an SE workshop next week to run the first pass.

Thanks,
Dylan
